title: CFTC reserve-representation context for Tether
summary: The CFTC published an order involving Tether and historical reserve representations. SOG records this as historical regulatory reserve context, not as a current reserve conclusion or safety score.
notes: Added in PR-018D. Keep separate from current transparency and assurance report entries.

title: MakerDAO / Sky lifecycle transition context
summary: MakerDAO's Sky transition and related token/product changes should be recorded as protocol lifecycle context. SOG keeps DAI, Sky, USDS, MKR/SKY, savings products, and collateral mechanisms separated until exact source-backed lifecycle records are added.
notes: Added in PR-018D. Date should be refined when exact announcement or proposal sources are selected.

title: Paxos BUSD wind-down and issuance halt context
summary: Paxos announced it would stop issuing new BUSD and end its relationship with Binance for the Binance USD stablecoin. SOG records this as wind-down context, not as failed status.
notes: Deepened in PR-018C. Additional official regulator source details can be added later.

title: BUSD exchange support phase-out context
summary: Binance announced a gradual phase-out of BUSD product support. SOG records exchange support phase-out separately from Paxos issuer redemption and wind-down status.
notes: Exchange notice. Do not treat as issuer redemption source.

title: Reported SEC follow-up context for Paxos BUSD
summary: Reuters reported a later SEC-related follow-up involving Paxos and BUSD. SOG records this only as reported follow-up context until an official source is added.
notes: News source, not official SEC/Paxos source. Keep wording cautious.

title: SEC action involving Terraform Labs and TerraUSD context
summary: The U.S. SEC announced an action involving Terraform Labs and Do Kwon after the Terra ecosystem collapse. SOG records this as regulatory context connected to the UST history, not as a standalone status label.
notes: Deepened in PR-018B. Later court actions should be handled in later source-backed updates.

title: USTC and Luna Classic post-collapse lifecycle context
summary: Post-collapse USTC and Luna Classic activity should be recorded as lifecycle context, not as evidence that UST recovered as a functioning stablecoin.
notes: Research source used for lifecycle framing only. Do not treat as official issuer statement.

title: USDC banking exposure context during Silicon Valley Bank failure
summary: Circle disclosed USDC reserve exposure to Silicon Valley Bank during the March 2023 banking crisis. SOG records this as banking/regulatory context connected to the recovered USDC depeg event.
notes: This is banking context, not a regulatory action against USDC. Keep separate from status and safety claims.

title: USDC operations reopening context after March 2023 banking weekend
summary: Circle stated that USDC operations would open for business after U.S. federal banking actions during the March 2023 banking weekend. SOG records this as recovery context connected to the recovered depeg event.
notes: Operational recovery context, not a safety score or investment claim.

title: FSA requests FY2027 tax-reporting measure for trust-type stablecoins
summary: Japan's Financial Services Agency included a requested FY2027 tax measure for specified trust beneficial interests used as trust-type stablecoins. JPYSC is linked because SBI Shinsei Trust Bank identifies JPYSC as a trust-type yen stablecoin and discloses its issued amount as specified trust beneficial interests. This is a policy request, not an enacted exemption or effective-law change.
notes: Applicability is grounded in JPYSC's existing canonical trust-issued classification and the issuer's current JPYSC disclosure page. Track later tax-reform outline, legislation, enactment and effective date separately; do not describe the requested exemption as already adopted.
